subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Agent Collaboration Enhancement: Capability Profiling + Shared Blackboard + Layered Memory + Token Cost Governance

question: Should this RFC become core API/scaffolding work, a narrow core MVP, or plugin/ClawHub-owned orchestration?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses persistent state, memory visibility, delegation authority, config/defaults, and budget enforcement, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary safely.

options.title: Core API/scaffold only
options.body: Define generic plugin/SDK/state hooks for blackboard, memory visibility, and budget governance while keeping heavy orchestration implementations outside core.

options.title: Narrow core MVP
options.body: Approve one small first phase such as performance-record collection or budget reporting only after storage and security design are explicit.

options.title: Route to ClawHub
options.body: Close or redirect the broad orchestration implementation if maintainers decide existing primitives plus plugins are the intended path.

recommendation.title: Core API/scaffold only
recommendation.body: Define generic plugin/SDK/state hooks for blackboard, memory visibility, and budget governance while keeping heavy orchestration implementations outside core.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the agent/runtime surfaces and has already provided scoping guidance on related multi-agent RFCs.
